item.title: NFL will not reach prediction market deals before the season starts and will not allow team-level deals, Front Office Sports reports via GambleRss — Oct 24, 2026 · 8:15 AM ET
item.description: - **NFL will not reach prediction market deals before the season starts and will not allow team-level deals, Front Office Sports reports via GambleRss** — Front Office Sports reported the NFL has held talks with Kalshi, Polymarket and the CFTC but will have no prediction market deals in place when the regular season begins, and no team-level deals are currently allowed. The NHL partnered with both Kalshi and Polymarket last October and MLB reached a deal with Polymarket in March, while the NBA has yet to reach a deal but is expected to do so before the NFL. ([GambleRss](https://gamblerss.com/nfl-won-t-reach-prediction-market-deals-before-start-of-season-68314))
